risk_if_not_implemented: Without Automatic Fire Suppression, unauthorized individuals may gain physical access to facilities and equipment, enabling theft, tampering, damage or safety incidents. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), Physical / Environmental Damage (R-SF-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to natural threats NT-1, NT-2, NT-3, NT-4, NT-5, NT-6, NT-8, NT-10, NT-11, NT-12, NT-13, NT-14; Utility Service Disruption (MT-7), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Product Defect / Design Failure (MT-23), Infrastructure Failure / Degradation (MT-27).

compensating_control_1.name: Supporting Utilities
compensating_control_1.description: Facility security mechanisms exist to protect power equipment and power cabling for the system from damage and destruction.
compensating_control_1.justification: Supporting Utilities (PES-20) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Automatic Fire Suppression (PES-28.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Facility applicability. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Fire Protection
compensating_control_2.description: Facility security mechanisms exist to utilize and maintain fire suppression and detection devices/systems for the system that are supported by an independent energy source.
compensating_control_2.justification: Fire Protection (PES-26) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Automatic Fire Suppression (PES-28.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Facility applicability. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
